## Copy Guidelines
- Tone: Authoritative, precise, understated confidence. Not hype-y.
- Use real Astroware details where provided above. Use clear placeholder markers like [PLACEHOLDER] only where specific data is missing.
- Keep paragraphs short. Prefer punchy statements over long explanations.

## Technical Requirements
- All pages server-rendered or statically generated where possible
- SEO meta tags on every page (title, description, OG tags)
- Accessible (semantic HTML, proper heading hierarchy, alt text placeholders)
- Fast — no unnecessary JS bundles
- Working navigation across all pages
- Mobile hamburger menu
